name: slo-spec
description: Define service level objectives for a service from its critical user journeys — each SLI a good-events / valid-events ratio with both sides defined and measured where the user feels it, a target set from user need and history (checked against dependency SLOs), the error budget computed in minutes and bad requests at current traffic, multi-window burn-rate alerts with the budget consumed when each fires, low-traffic handling, and an error-budget policy with owners. Use when the user asks to "define SLOs", "write our SLIs", "how much error budget do we have", "what burn-rate alerts should page", "is 99.99% realistic", or "write an error-budget policy".

handoff.when: the SLIs are agreed and the telemetry to produce them doesn't exist yet
handoff.purpose: Design the instrumentation, logs, traces and dashboards behind the SLIs.
handoff.fallback: If observability-plan is absent, list per SLI the event source, the measurement point and the counter it needs, inline.

handoff.when: the burn-rate alerts are defined and each page needs a procedure
handoff.purpose: Write the steps on-call follows when each alert fires.
handoff.fallback: If runbook-generator is absent, write the first three checks for each paging alert inline.

permissions.notes: slo_math.py does arithmetic only; it reads an optional --batch JSON file or stdin and writes only the -o path the user names.

model.rationale: SLI choice is bounded judgment over user journeys; error-budget and burn-rate arithmetic is done by its script.
